fusions.name: Flicked Bristles
fusions.desc: Flicks barbed bristles in a cone out to 4 tiles, which deals 3 damage to everything caught in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bound in Strands
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy 3 times with strand-wrapped blows; each deals 10 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bristling Coat
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Felt Through the Setae
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
